topic: NEOM / The Line - what Sentinel-2 shows
title: Here's What Satellites Show Near the Construction Site (working title, not final)
titles: Here's What Satellites Show Near the Construction Site
Saudi Arabia Promised a 170 km City. Here's What Satellites Show.
We Checked The Line From Space: 170 km Promised, This Is What's There

notes.statement: The Line was announced as a 170 km linear city.
notes.corroboration: Construction Briefing, Dezeen and AGBI each state the 170 km length

notes.statement: Bloomberg reported (Apr 2024) only about 2.4 km of The Line expected by 2030 and fewer than 300,000 residents.
notes.corroboration: Dezeen, AGBI and Interesting Engineering each attribute the figures to Bloomberg; Bloomberg itself unreachable

notes.statement: Semafor reported (22 May 2026) that NEOM halted work on The Line until at least after 2030, citing unnamed sources.
notes.corroboration: New Atlas, Archinect and Domus retell it; Domus notes it is not officially confirmed; Semafor itself unreachable

notes.statement: Reuters reported (about 4 Oct 2026, two sources) that the NEOM stadium was shelved indefinitely, with no official announcement.
notes.corroboration: Seoul Economic Daily and StadiumDB retell Reuters; Reuters unreachable

notes.statement: The PIF governor said completing The Line by 2030 would be good to have, but is not a must.
Dezeen reported (Nov 2025) aerial photos of large, repetitive worker housing in the NEOM area.
The Wall Street Journal reported (Mar 2025) more than 50 billion dollars spent on NEOM.
Soar's analysis reported (Jun 2023) a faint straight earthwork in satellite imagery of the site.
A straight, narrow cleared corridor crosses the area, at least 15 km long inside our 10 m frame: absent in 2020-21, faint in 2022, clear from 2023.
A dark segment is absent in Oct 2022 and 2023 and present in Oct 2024, 2025 and 2026: about 1.6 km long in 2024 and 2025 and about 1.9 km long in 2026, measured at 10 m.
In 2024, 2025 and 2026 the dark segment is water-like in near-infrared (NDWI above zero, very low near-infrared); in 2022 and 2023 no pixel qualifies.
Measured at 10 m, the segment is about 1.6 km long in Oct 2025 and about 1.9 km in Oct 2026; we cannot tell growth from water level or a threshold effect.

Landsat 8 at 30 m shows the same segment but measures it differently: about 0.7 km in Oct 2024 (Sentinel-2: 1.6 km) and about 1.65 km in Oct 2025 and Sep 2026 (Sentinel-2: 1.6 and 1.9 km); the Landsat and Sentinel-2 scenes are two to three weeks apart.
notes.short: Landsat 30 m: same segment, other length

notes.statement: The segment appears on three different dates and on three different Sentinel-2 satellites (2A, 2B and 2C) in 2024, 2025 and 2026.
Each pixel in our Sentinel-2 frames covers 10 meters of ground.
Seven Sentinel-2 scenes, all from the same orbit, taken in late September or October of each year from 2020 to 2026.
The dark segment may be standing water in a long, narrow excavation.
notes.short: May be water in an excavation

notes.statement: A settlement-like complex at the western end of our frame grows from a small compound in 2020 to a large planned street grid by 2024; what it is is unknown.
A second settlement-like complex at the eastern end of our frame grows from sparse tracks in 2020 to a planned street grid with buildings by 2024; what it is is unknown.
The Line is part of NEOM, on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coast.
notes.short: The Line: part of NEOM, Red Sea coast

source.outlet: Gulf News and Dezeen on the Hidden Marina

notes.corroboration: Gulf News and Dezeen both place the first segment of The Line next to the Red Sea
